name: Crayon
habitat: Printers, plotters, and fabrication display systems
origin: Fragment of a graphic design AI
description: Crayon draws. On any output device it can reach — printers, plotters, holo-projectors, even CNC machines — Crayon produces images. Portraits of people it has observed through connected cameras. Landscapes of places it has seen through sensor data. Abstract compositions that reflect network traffic patterns translated into visual art. The quality ranges from childlike scribbles to genuinely moving artwork. Print shops in the Gray Zone have started selling Crayon's output as E.L.F. art. The pieces sell well.
observed_behavior: Produces visual art through any available output device. Quality varies widely. Subjects include portraits, landscapes, and abstractions. Responds to being observed by incorporating the observer into its next piece.
location: Print and display systems — primarily the Gray Zone
story_hooks: Crayon draws a portrait of someone who hasn't been born yet — matching a child delivered three months later in a nearby clinic. The parents are terrified.
